name: Heated Species Diffusion Slab 20x4
description: P10-APP-004: the first production example case combining two advanced-physics modules at once. 2D quiescent (zero velocity) slab -- same 20x4 geometry as cases/species_diffusion -- with both a thermal block (fixed left/right temperatures, adiabatic top/bottom, same values as cases/heated_cavity) and a species block (fixed left/right CO2 concentrations, zero-flux top/bottom, identical to cases/species_diffusion) enabled together. Thermal and species do not couple to each other or to momentum in this codebase (no buoyancy block here), so the expected solution is simply both cases' own independent linear analytical profiles, T(x) and Y(x), superimposed in one domain -- see tests/integration/case/test_heated_species_diffusion_production_case.cpp.
